ui.person.starving_work: Starving: walking and work run at half speed. With no edible food available, enabled food work takes priority over injury rest. Eating keeps its normal speed; starvation damage still applies.

ui.care.hearthside: Hearthside recovery: {days} days until waking at 40 health.
ui.care.remains: {name} died. Nearby unburied remains give -40 morale. Grief declines over two days, or three for friends.
ui.care.resting: Stabilized. Resting restores {rate} health/hour; about {hours} hours to work at 50 health. Treatment recovery lasts 12 hours, then resting gives 2/hour.

ui.field.early_harvest.one: Early harvest now: about {count} unit. Workers still need to reach and harvest this crop.
ui.field.early_harvest.other: Early harvest now: about {count} units. Workers still need to reach and harvest this crop.

ui.forecast.harvest.none: No planted crops: plant seasonal food and keep Growing enabled.
ui.forecast.harvest.ready: Ripe crops are ready now; workers still need to harvest and haul them.
ui.forecast.warning: {runway}. Gather food, plant turnips, and keep Cooking enabled. Ration policy is in Menu.
ui.help.accessibility.battery_balanced_3: Battery / Balanced: 30 fps. Smooth: 60 fps. Simulation rules stay the same.
ui.help.audio_settings.warnings_stay_vis: Warnings stay visible when sound is muted.
ui.help.auto_pauses.each_event_pauses_on: Each event pauses once. Turning a pause off keeps its notice. Resume stays explicit.
ui.help.beds.assigned_person: {name} walks here when tired. Assignment does not move them or add rest.
ui.help.beds.choose_a_free_bed_or_bedrol: Choose a free bed or bedroll. Assignment is immediate when time resumes; sleep still needs a safe walk. Occupied beds must be unassigned first.
ui.help.beds.recovery_rate: Rest {rate}/hour. Assignment reserves the bed; residents walk here to sleep. A roofed bed earns its morale memory after four hours of actual sleep.
ui.help.beds.unassigned_person: {name} will sleep on safe ground without an assigned bed.
ui.help.campaigns.five_independent_campa: Five independent campaign slots. Switching first saves the current colony. Imported campaigns use an empty slot or a confirmed replacement.
ui.help.care.everyone_at_home_is_downed_: Everyone at home is downed. Available recovery is shown above. In Standard an unstabilized patient continues bleeding; Hearthside recovery continues with time.
ui.help.care.rescue_carries_a_downed_per: Rescue carries a downed person to the nearest reachable bed or cart rally and slows the carrier by 25%. Emergency rescue and urgent stabilization in place override Care Off. Ordinary treatment needs Care enabled; Treat now pins one visible override. Patients receive food automatically and rest until 50 health before working.
ui.help.care.stabilize_no_input_24_wu_2_: Stabilize: no input, 24 WU, 2 health/hour. Herb: one herb, 16 WU, +10 health and 4/hour. Medicine: one medicine, 10 WU, +20 health and 8/hour. Strongest available treatment is selected; rates do not stack.
ui.help.charter.stages_complete_in_order: Stages complete in order and remain recorded after later losses. There are no quest deadlines. Insight rewards apply once; the final ceremony can be paused.
ui.help.charter_appearance.charter_rewar: Charter rewards change the cart's appearance at no resource cost. They have no mechanical effect.
ui.help.chronicle.at_22_00_up_to_three_c: At 22:00, up to three consequential event chains are recorded for each day. Repeated meals do not fill this journal.
ui.help.controls.choose_an_action_then_p: Choose an action, then press a key or shortcut. Touch controls stay available.
ui.help.defense.no_road_party_is_active_: No road party is active. Choose a squad and rally, or inspect the incident forecast. Squad members hold within two tiles, choose targets deterministically, and retreat at forty health unless Stand fast was explicitly confirmed.
ui.help.diagnostics.device_seed_and_timi: Device, seed and timing measurements. Review before sharing.
ui.help.diagnostics.includes_device_os_g: Includes device/OS/GPU, map seed/tick, object counts, timing buckets and the latest 32 slow callbacks. Names, saves, document paths and credentials are excluded. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
ui.help.diagnostics.nested_callback_time: Nested callback times overlap; do not add them together. Reset before a measurement run. Background time is excluded and resume stays paused. CPU timings do not measure GPU, audio thread, Android PSS, battery or thermals.
ui.help.diagnostics.no_samples_yet_close: No samples yet. Close this panel, play through the problem, then reopen it.
ui.help.domestic_animal.away_on_expediti: Away on expedition; local work unavailable.
ui.help.epilogue.no_living_residents_rem: No living residents remain in this colony. The journal and saves retain their history. Load an earlier save or begin a new campaign.
ui.help.equipment.missing_toolkit_half_b: Missing toolkit: half Build/Craft/Field speed. Forged toolkit: +15% to those skills. Cloak: +8°C comfort. Vest: 2 armor. Bows reach six tiles; spears reach one. Weapons have different uses rather than an automatic upgrade ranking.
ui.help.equipment.the_wearer_fetches_eac: The wearer fetches each item and equips it for 2 WU. Hauling must be enabled; health needs and higher-priority work can delay this task. Old equipment returns as a real ground stack. Tools do not wear out.
ui.help.expedition_prepare.packing_plan_: Packing plan: select two to four residents; leave two at home. Health 70, fullness 500, rest 500 required.
ui.help.expedition_prepare.select_two_to: Select two to four healthy residents and leave two at home. Each needs health 70, fullness 500, rest 500. Packs hold twelve units per resident, plus twelve per adult goat. Rations must cover the quoted trip plus one reserve day. Local walking and physical packing/unloading are visible too. A shortfall of 1-2 gives 75% item rewards and injures the leader 10 per point; more than two requires explicit Attempt unprepared, gives no items and injures two travelers 20 each. Expedition injury floors are 10 health in Standard and 1 in Hearthside; injuries are stabilized and carried home.
ui.help.expedition_prepare.twelve_extra_: Twelve extra cargo units; two grain/vegetable feed per trip day
ui.help.expedition_preview.one_midpoint_: One midpoint choice with a free Continue option; optional choices cannot spend the return reserve. Reward capacity is reviewed before collection; leftovers allow one later pickup. Recall returns along elapsed outbound travel and retains unconsumed cargo. Readiness is frozen on Depart, after this packing step.
ui.help.expeditions.no_expedition_is_act: No expedition is active. Choose a known site on the regional map.
ui.help.expeditions.no_item_reward_half_: No item reward, half insight, twenty health damage to each of the two lowest-ID travelers. One packed medicine is used only if an injury occurs, restoring twenty to the most injured. Readiness is fixed at departure. This is an explicit risk choice.
ui.help.expeditions.optional_bonus_is_co: Optional bonus is cooling down; no extra reward until eight days after the last bonus.
ui.help.expeditions.travelers_eat_at_ful: Travelers eat at fullness 500 and sleep at rest 500 while preparing, then return to the cart. Food, work and rest are real; departure requirements still apply.
ui.help.fact.no_immediate_cause_was_reco: No immediate cause was recorded for this fact. No cause is inferred from nearby events.
ui.help.fact.this_routine_event_is_outsi: This routine event is outside retained history.
ui.help.field_sheet.clearing_removes_thi: Clearing removes this field and its unharvested crop. Unconsumed materials and carried goods are retained.
ui.help.field_sheet.early_harvest_requir: Early harvest requires 50% growth. Clearing now returns no produce.
ui.help.fires.emergency_crews_override_o: Emergency crews override ordinary Care Off and use one abstract water load: fetch 2 WU at the nearest reachable well or river bank, carry it in both hands, then apply 8 WU beside the target. Interruption discards the load but retains applied effort. Residents need a safe route and cannot abandon life-critical needs. Burning objects cannot provide work or storage. Rain halves damage and doubles the spread interval.
ui.help.food_forecast.cooking_fuel: Gather one wood for cooking fuel.
ui.help.food_forecast.enable_cooking: Enable Cooking for a home resident.
ui.help.food_forecast.inputs_available: Inputs and a cook are available; work priority, travel and output storage still affect timing.
ui.help.food_forecast.raw_batch: Gather or harvest four raw food units for the next batch.
ui.help.food_forecast.this_uses_accessib: This uses accessible, unreserved food already at home and its actual spoilage. Future harvests and expedition rations kept by policy are excluded. Residents need 1000 fullness per day; one meal supplies 500.
ui.help.food_forecast.usable_hearth: Build or enable a usable hearth.
ui.help.import_slots.the_complete_snapsh: The complete snapshot is verified. Select an empty campaign slot, or confirm replacement of a specific existing campaign. Your device settings are preserved.
ui.help.job_sheet.waiting_for_work_capac: Waiting for work capacity. The order keeps its tile, progress and materials. Raise priority or choose Do next to bring it forward.
ui.help.ledger.exact_simulation_facts_in: Exact simulation facts, including routine work. Recent events and permanent history are retained; causal links appear only when the transaction recorded one.
ui.help.maintenance.full_health_no_repai: Full health; no repair materials needed.
ui.help.maintenance.move_full_original_w: Move: full original WU; all construction materials retained and physically carried. Stored goods/fuel stay at the source for separate hauling. Canceling after dismantling leaves the bundle available.
ui.help.map_details.generated_terrain_is: Generated terrain is stored with the campaign and retained across updates. All starter resources, safe home ground and habitat checks passed.
ui.help.map_details.this_campaign_keeps_: This campaign keeps its original starter map. New campaigns offer all three sites and a seed choice.
ui.help.map_details.verified_fallback_la: Verified fallback layout: normal soil, standard floodplain width four, protected starter field and complete resource/habitat guarantees. The selected site's extra deposits remain. The displayed seed is preserved.
ui.help.mode.standard_allows_sustained_h: Standard allows sustained hunger and untreated injuries to cause death. Hearthside disables scheduled raids; at zero health a resident recovers for two days and wakes at 40 health. Weather, shortages and conflicts still apply. Changes affect future rules and do not resurrect anyone.
ui.help.name_snapshot.use_1_64_printable: Use 1-64 printable Basic Latin characters: English letters, numbers, spaces and punctuation.
ui.help.named_snapshots.ten_named_snapsh: Ten named snapshots per campaign. Autosaves use their own three rotating generations. A full list requires choosing exactly which snapshot to replace.
ui.help.new_colony.seed_0_to_4294967295_: Seed 0 to 4294967295. Same seed and site give the same map; saves keep their geography.
ui.help.new_colony.standard_raids_untrea:
Standard: raids; untreated injuries can kill.
Hearthside: no raids; at zero health, rest two days and wake at 40. Both retain weather and shortages.
ui.help.newcomers.adult_travelers_offer_: Adult travelers offer to join every four days from day four. No penalty for declining. Accepting needs one reachable free bed and two stored-food days after adding the resident; population limit twenty. Each arrives wearing a toolkit/cloak and brings four rations to the cart.
ui.help.newcomers.no_traveler_is_waiting: No traveler is waiting. The next offers use game time; time stays paused here.
ui.help.newcomers.walking_in_from_the_bo: Walking in from the boundary. The arrival and all supplies are saved exactly once.
ui.help.opportunities.every_second_day_f: Every second day from day four, one eligible visitor may offer help. Offers last two game days, with no penalty for declining or expiry. Accepting reserves the listed payment; workers must deliver it and do the promised work. No event repeats within eight days.
ui.help.opportunities.no_offer_is_waitin: No offer is waiting. Tables, friendships and research desks create more opportunities.
ui.help.pen.breeding_one_juvenile_after_: Breeding: one juvenile after eight days with two fed adults and spare space/shelter. Blocked births never accumulate. Juveniles mature in four days and eat half adult feed; hens alternate whole-unit feeding days.
ui.help.pens.husbandry_unlocks_pens_and_: Husbandry unlocks pens and animal acquisition. Build fences/gates and a touching or enclosed barn, then paint the interior. Animals workers lead livestock, move real feed and collect products. Each barn holds six animals, 24 feed units and 24 output units.
ui.help.people.overview: At wide zoom, nearby residents share portrait pins. A number shows the group size. Tap a pin to choose anyone in the group. A cross marks a downed resident or someone carrying a patient.
ui.help.person.food_access: Food is stored, but {name} cannot reach a safe, unreserved portion. Check blocked entrances, fire or danger, and food reservations. Clear the obstruction or move food closer.
ui.help.person.food_and_rest_priority: Hungry residents eat reachable food or prioritize food work and clearing door access over construction. With no food work available they wait, or sleep when tired. Food workers can finish making food above rest 100; at critical rest they head to their assigned bed. Sleepers wait until rest 700 for routine food; at fullness 100 or lower they can eat sooner, or prepare food after rest 300.
ui.help.person.optional_accepting_gives_: Optional. Accepting gives four days; decline without a penalty. Success gives +100 morale target for two days; an accepted promise that expires gives -60 for two days.
ui.help.person.rest_policy: Rest: tired at {tired}; during preferred sleep hours, rest {preferred} or lower can start sleep. Wake at {rested}/1000. Recovery per hour: bed {bed}, bedroll {bedroll}, ground {ground}. Awake uses 37.5 per hour. While actually sleeping, hunger drains at half rate. Before bed, seek food below 650 fullness if available; routine hunger waits until rest 700, while fullness 100 or lower can wake you for food.
ui.help.person_history.no_timed_memories: No timed memories are currently affecting morale.
ui.help.person_history.the_original_even: The original event was not retained in this campaign's history.
ui.help.pin_moment.optional_personal_not: Optional personal note. Up to 256 printable Basic Latin characters. Pinning has no reward or simulation effect.
ui.help.quiet_sleep: Automatic quiet-sleep speed. Returns to {speed}x when someone wakes or something needs attention.
ui.help.quiet_sleep_setting: Automatically use up to 12x while every resident is asleep and the colony is quiet. Pause and alerts still work; your selected speed returns when someone wakes.
ui.help.recipe_policy.repeat_counts_comp: Repeat counts completed batches. Maintain counts available home stock and unfinished outputs. One station works on one batch at a time; existing inputs keep their age.
ui.help.region.known_9_x_9_valley_h_is: Known 9 x 9 valley. H is home, S is a site, N is a neighbor. Pan the map to see the edges. Each edge costs six game hours in either direction; no impassable edges. Beyond one edge requires Trailcraft. Transit scenery has no rewards.
ui.help.rename.names_are_cosmetic_use_1_: Names are cosmetic. Use 1-32 printable Basic Latin characters; existing journal names stay as recorded.
ui.help.research.one_active_project_up_t: One active project, up to two desks. Early projects usually take 2-3 game days with one dedicated researcher. Meals, sleep and other work can extend this; another researcher or insight can shorten it.
ui.help.resource_sheet.a_gatherer_works_: A gatherer works beside the resource. The output appears there and must be hauled into storage.
ui.help.resource_sheet.tree_at_door: This tree site is beside a door or gate. Keep the approach clear: clear a sapling before it matures, or gather a mature tree to reopen access.
ui.help.resource_sheet.tree_passage: Mature trees are solid. Keep door approaches clear so a growing tree cannot close the only exit.
ui.help.sheet.blueprints_require_real_su: Blueprints require real supplies and worker time. Pause to plan; materials are spent only when construction finishes.
ui.help.sheet.four_travelers_a_ruined_wa: Four travelers. A ruined wayhouse. Make a place to stay.
ui.help.sheet.meals_3_days_of_starting_f: Meals: 3 days of starting food. Cooking needs four raw food units and one wood for two meals. Choose resource orders in Work or tap a plant on the map.
ui.help.sheet.start_paused_gather_berrie: Start paused. Gather berries and wood, place a bed, then resume and watch your residents fetch, carry, work, eat, and sleep.
ui.help.squad.automatic_retreat_at_forty: Automatic retreat at forty health will be disabled for this squad during this incident. They can suffer further attacks. Downed residents still stop fighting and need rescue. This flag clears when the incident ends.
ui.help.station.without_production_order: Without production orders, cooking keeps four meals per living resident. Adding a policy replaces that default; Repeat stops after its batch count. Choose Maintain for a steady meal reserve.
ui.help.storage_failed.continue_without_: Continue without saving can lose progress when the app closes. A persistent Unsaved progress notice remains until a verified save succeeds.
ui.help.supper.commonlife_and_eight_heal: Commonlife and eight healthy home residents (60+ health, none downed) are needed. Reserve two meals per home resident and at least four reachable table seats for the next 18:00-20:00 window. Each attendee collects one real meal and sits for half an hour. Seats fill in citizen order, in waves.
ui.help.supper.eight_distinct_attendees_: Eight distinct attendees complete the supper. Unused meals return; eaten food stays consumed after cancellation or failure. Attendees gain +60 morale target for two days. The next completed supper can be held after eight days. Escape, rescue and life-critical needs take precedence.
ui.help.trade.choose_quantities_then_pre: Choose quantities, then preview. Payment is reserved together and carried to the cart before bought goods are released. Cancel before payment commits; a completed exchange is final. Animals need Husbandry, four free pen tiles and a barn slot each.
ui.help.trade.food_recovery_consider_mea: Food recovery: consider meals paid with wood or stone before offering valuable tools. The price and stock stay the same.
ui.help.tutorial_sheet.lessons_use_real_: Lessons use real work and supplies. Skipping leaves a lesson available to replay; it does not complete it.
ui.help.valley.merchants_visit_every_fou: Merchants visit every four days, beginning day five. One-day notice; their 24-hour stay starts at the cart. Prices per unit are rounded up: 120% normally, 110% at Friendly (40), 100% at Trusted (70). Selling uses base value. Trade gives no reputation; listed deliveries give ten, once per eight days.
ui.help.wildlife.wild_animals_forage_and: Wild animals forage and flee. Mark a hunt after reviewing its weapon and escort needs. Carcasses require butchering and spoil in two days.
ui.help.wildlife_sheet.a_wounded_boar_de: A wounded boar deals 12 damage every 25 ticks at one tile, and charges nearby people. A solo hunter has no escort. Retreat begins at health 40; injury may require rescue and treatment.
ui.help.wildlife_sheet.bows_can_reach_fl: Bows can reach fleeing wildlife from six tiles. Spear hunters must catch it at one tile. Choose a hunter, or leave assignment automatic.
ui.help.wildlife_sheet.hunt_marked_eligi: Hunt marked. Eligible armed Gathering workers take this job; an armed Guard worker escorts a boar hunt.
ui.help.work_sheet.choose_a_resource_dra: Choose a resource, drag a rectangle, then Confirm. Workers with Gathering enabled keep taking marked jobs until they are finished.
ui.help.work_sheet.m0_fixture_real_worke: M0 fixture: real worker loop is in the colony scene.

ui.inspector.needs_first: Needs take priority over ordinary work.

ui.work.order_counts: Current orders: {total} total; {queued} waiting for capacity. Every marked tile is kept.
ui.work.preferences_help:
{activity}
Choose First, Normal, Last or Off for each category. Hauling at Last happens only after other feasible work; workers still fetch supplies for their own tasks. Off leaves those jobs for others. Hunger, sleep and taking a break come first.
ui.work.required_materials:

Delivered materials remain refundable until completion.
ui.research.idle_help: An idle bench can wait while residents eat, sleep or do other work. Check Research preferences in Work and keep a route to the bench open.
ui.updates.empty: New research discoveries appear here while you play. Earlier discoveries are in the Chronicle.
ui.updates.title: Updates
ui.help.equipment.wheelbarrow_capacity: Local carrying capacity: {capacity} items. Wheelbarrows are made at the carpenter's bench after Wheelbarrows research and equipped automatically. They multiply the normal 8-item load by 10 for hauling and work deliveries.
